vulnerabilities.title: Strict Transport Security header missing
vulnerabilities.description: The HTTPS dashboard response does not include HSTS.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add Strict-Transport-Security with an appropriate max-age and preload policy.

vulnerabilities.title: X-Content-Type-Options header missing
vulnerabilities.description: The dashboard response does not enforce MIME sniffing protection.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Set X-Content-Type-Options to nosniff on HTTPS responses.

vulnerabilities.title: Login SQL injection error-disclosure probe completed
vulnerabilities.description: A single-quote input and invalid password were submitted to the login form. No common database error signature was visible in the response; this does not prove the endpoint is free of SQL injection.
vulnerabilities.remediation: For stronger assurance, review server-side parameterized queries and test in a dedicated authorized environment.
vulnerabilities.evidence: One non-destructive single-quote input submitted; no database error signature detected
vulnerabilities.expectedResult: Generic authentication error without database details
